about_the_game:
Realm of Beasts and Artifice - An RPG combining idle combat, spirit beast cultivation, and sect management

Core Gameplay Systems

1. Combat & Progression System

    []

    Intelligent idle combat system

    []

    Multi-dimensional equipment system (affixes/set bonuses/quality tiers)

    []

    Skill matrix system (200+ combinable skill modules)

    []

    Spirit beast squad system (strategic 5-beast team compositions)

2. Immortal Cultivation System

    []

    Nine-stage ascension system (Qi Refining → Tribulation Transcendence)

    []

    Lifespan countdown mechanic (permanent death upon expiration)

3. Bestiary Codex System

    []

    Species unlock through beast taming

    []

    Ancestral legacy network (activated species grant racial bonuses)

4. Celestial Forge System

    []

    Five Elements smithy (elemental material fusion)

    []

    Equipment crafting

    []

    Affix refinement (targeted attribute extraction/transfer)

5. Dynamic World System

    []

    Main story with 300+ branching narratives

    []

    Permanent NPC death (key characters' fate alters worldlines)

    []

    Zone-based exploration (Seven Divine Realms + hidden domains)

6. Sect Ecosystem

    []

    Nine-rank hierarchy system (Outer Disciple → Grand Elder)

    []

    Monthly stipend resources (position-based spirit stone/items)

    []

    Archival Vault secrets (unlock ancient techniques with contribution)

    []

    Seasonal Four Symbols Tournament (sect ranking battles)

7. Spirit Refinement Pagoda

    []

    Five Elements environment control

    []

    Evolutionary tree system (basic forms → primordial variants)

  • Environmental adaptation mechanics:

▫ Incubation boost (Wood realm accelerates plant-type eggs)

▫ Bloodline purification (compatible elements trigger rare affixes)

▫ Core refinement (element alignment enhances absorption)

▫ Beast reincarnation (fallen companions revive with random buffs)

▫ Pagoda trials (dynamic elemental counters)
